Barbell Rollout from Bench

Barbell Rollout from Bench is an intermediate compound exercise targeting the core. It uses barbell and is suitable for intermediate trainees.

Specialist movement. This is a sport-specific or conditioning drill that we keep for reference. It is not part of our main exercise library or planner. Looking for standard strength exercises? Browse the exercise library.

How To Perform

  1. 1 Place a loaded barbell on the ground, near the end of a bench. Kneel with both legs on the bench, and take a medium to narrow grip on the barbell. This will be your starting position.
  2. 2 To begin, extend through the hips to slowly roll the bar forward. As you roll out, flex the shoulder to roll the bar above your head. Ensure that your arms remain extended throughout the movement.
  3. 3 When the bar has been moved as far forward as possible, return to the starting position.

Form Cues

  • ✓ Focus on controlled movement throughout each rep.
  • ✓ Maintain proper alignment and avoid compensating with other muscle groups.
  • ✓ Breathe out during the exertion phase of the movement.

Common Mistakes

  • ✗ Using too much weight before mastering the technique.
  • ✗ Rushing through reps — prioritize control over speed.
  • ✗ Not achieving full range of motion on each repetition.
💡 Professor Splits Says:

Progressive overload is the engine of muscle growth. Track your weights and aim to add small increments weekly. For Barbell Rollout from Bench, this means gradually increasing load, volume (sets × reps), or decreasing rest periods over time.

FAQ

How many sets of Barbell Rollout from Bench should I do?▾
3–4 sets of 8–12 reps is a solid starting point. Adjust based on your training frequency and overall weekly volume for core. Beginners should start with the lower end; advanced trainees can push toward the upper range.
What muscles does Barbell Rollout from Bench target?▾
Barbell Rollout from Bench primarily targets the Core. Secondary muscles include Glutes, Hamstrings, Lats.
Is Barbell Rollout from Bench good for beginners?▾
Barbell Rollout from Bench is rated intermediate. Beginners should build foundational strength first with simpler movements.
How much rest between sets?▾
For Barbell Rollout from Bench, 90 sec of rest between sets is recommended. Compound exercises require more recovery — longer rests (2–3 min) allow better performance on the next set.
